notes:
Cloud sync could resurrect a mod you had just uninstalled. The Thunderstore mirror handed the pull the other device's whole Thunderstore list and installed whatever was missing locally, with no regard for the per-mod tombstone your uninstall had created - then the reinstall stamped a fresh watermark and pushed the mod straight back to the device that removed it. Server Devcommands kept reappearing on Emma's laptop after she deleted it, and landed on Rik's profile alongside MegaCommander.

The Thunderstore list is now merged as a union minus tombstones, and a pull never hands the mirror a mod the ledger says was removed. Uninstall a Thunderstore mod on one device and it now stays gone everywhere.

Also in this build's manifest: MegaCommander 1.0.3 strips a co-installed Server Devcommands instead of standing down for it (a stale 1.109 threw a NullReference every physics tick and killed item pickup); MegaQoL 1.23.0 Forge of Potential odds slider and one-pass bulk refine; MegaStuff 1.7.1 auto-pickup buffer fix; MegaFactory 1.9.0 Frigid Kiln work orders.
